title: Petra and the Inventory
author: Elodie Crane
blurb: Casper Reyes, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
